t.zh: 一块地上长着几棵树。想在空地上铺一块正方形的草坪，四条边和格子对齐，不能压到树。最大能铺多大？
t.en: A field has a few trees on it. You want to lay a square lawn on the open ground, lined up with the cells, without covering a tree. How big can it be?

t.zh: 地的上边和左边围着一圈 0，表示地外。答案是正方形的边长。
t.en: The field is ringed above and to the left by 0s, meaning outside the field. The answer is the square’s side.

goal.zh: 算出最大的正方形草坪的边长。
goal.en: Work out the side of the biggest square lawn.

how.zh: 答案是整张表里最大的数。
how.en: The answer is the largest number anywhere in the table.

hints.zh: 答案是整张表里最大的数。每一格里的数，该描述一个什么样的正方形？
hints.en: The answer is the largest number in the table. What square should the number in each cell describe?

hints.zh: 让每一格只回答一个问题：以它为右下角的正方形，最大能有多大？
hints.en: Let each cell answer one question only: how big can a square be whose bottom-right corner it is?

body.zh: 一格存的是「以我为右下角的最大正方形边长」。它比上面、左边、左上三格里最小的那个多 1：任何一边短了，正方形都撑不大。
body.en: A cell holds “the side of the biggest square whose bottom-right corner I am”. It is one more than the smallest of the cells above, to the left and up-left: if any of them is short, the square can’t grow.

body.zh: 树下面是 0：「加起来」汇合器把「—」跳过，只剩常数 0。
body.en: Under a tree it is 0: the “sum” merger skips the “—” and only the Constant 0 is left.

body.zh: 难的不是接线，是想清楚一格该存什么。
body.en: The hard part was not the wiring but deciding what a cell should hold.
